searchText: Quick question regarding the engine API methods `engine_getPayloadBodiesByRangeV1` and `engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV1` > Client software MUST support request sizes of at least 32 block hashes. The call MUST return -38004: Too large request error if the number of requested payload bodies is too large. Is the too large number subjective to each EL client? The upper limit on the size is implementation dependent according to the way the spec puts it

excerpts.author: gfukushima
excerpts.content:
Quick question regarding the engine API methods `engine_getPayloadBodiesByRangeV1` and `engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV1`
> Client software MUST support request sizes of at least 32 block hashes. The call MUST return -38004: Too large request error if the number of requested payload bodies is too large.

Is the too large number subjective to each EL client?

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: The upper limit on the size is implementation dependent according to the way the spec puts it
